control.description: Call commands and events as JSON text. Send call.hello within five seconds of connecting, then wait for hello.
control.title: The control socket

media.description: Audio for one call you own, as JSON text with base64 PCM. Send media.attach within five seconds of connecting, then wait for media.ready. Binary messages are rejected.

call.description: ID of the call whose audio the socket carries.

media.title: The media socket

client.audio.chunk.name: audio.chunk
client.audio.chunk.summary: A chunk of PCM audio. You send it on your track; the daemon sends it on receive tracks.
client.audio.chunk.title: CallMediaCommand[audio.chunk]

client.audio.start.name: audio.start
client.audio.start.summary: Start sending audio on your track for a generation. Send it before the first chunk, and again after each new generation.
client.audio.start.title: CallMediaCommand[audio.start]

client.call.answer.name: call.answer
client.call.answer.summary: Answer the incoming call. The first client to answer owns the call; others get `already_claimed`.
client.call.answer.title: CallCommand[call.answer]

client.call.cancel.name: call.cancel
client.call.cancel.summary: Cancel your outgoing call before the other side picks up.
client.call.cancel.title: CallCommand[call.cancel]

client.call.clear_audio.name: call.clear_audio
client.call.clear_audio.summary: Discard queued outgoing audio, for example to interrupt a reply. This starts a new send generation, announced by `track.updated`.
client.call.clear_audio.title: CallCommand[call.clear_audio]

client.call.dial.name: call.dial
client.call.dial.summary: Start an outgoing call. The socket becomes the call's owner.
client.call.dial.title: CallCommand[call.dial]

client.call.hangup.name: call.hangup
client.call.hangup.summary: End a call after answering or connecting. In a conference this leaves the call without ending it for the others.
client.call.hangup.title: CallCommand[call.hangup]

client.call.hello.name: call.hello
client.call.hello.summary: Announce the protocol versions this client supports. Send it within five seconds of opening the control socket, before any command.
client.call.hello.title: CallClientHello[call.hello]

client.call.invite.name: call.invite
client.call.invite.summary: Invite more contacts into a connected conference call you own. Results arrive as `call.invitation_result`.
client.call.invite.title: CallCommand[call.invite]

client.call.join.name: call.join
client.call.join.summary: Join a conference call from one of the listed invitations. The socket becomes the call's owner, as with `call.dial`.
client.call.join.title: CallCommand[call.join]

client.call.mute.name: call.mute
client.call.mute.summary: Mute or unmute your outgoing audio. This also clears queued audio and starts a new send generation, announced by `track.updated`.
client.call.mute.title: CallCommand[call.mute]

client.call.ready.name: call.ready
client.call.ready.summary: Advertise or withdraw readiness to handle call audio. A new connection is passive until it advertises readiness.
client.call.ready.title: CallCommand[call.ready]

client.media.attach.name: media.attach
client.media.attach.summary: Attach the socket to a call you own. Send it first, within five seconds of connecting; the daemon answers `media.ready`.
client.media.attach.title: CallMediaCommand[media.attach]

server.audio.chunk.name: audio.chunk
server.audio.chunk.summary: A chunk of PCM audio. You send it on your track; the daemon sends it on receive tracks.
server.audio.chunk.title: CallMediaCommand[audio.chunk]

server.call.control.name: call.control
server.call.control.summary: The other party of a direct call changed a control, such as muting their microphone. It needs no reply.
server.call.control.title: CallEvent[call.control]

server.call.error.name: call.error
server.call.error.summary: A failure that is not tied to a command, such as an invalid message or a missing permission. The daemon then closes the socket, except for `outcome_unknown`, which follows `hello` and leaves it open.
server.call.error.title: CallEvent[call.error]

server.call.invitation_result.name: call.invitation_result
server.call.invitation_result.summary: The outcome of each invited contact for a create or invite command, sent to the call's owner.
server.call.invitation_result.title: CallEvent[call.invitation_result]

server.call.offered.name: call.offered
server.call.offered.summary: An incoming call that can be answered or rejected now.
server.call.offered.title: CallEvent[call.offered]

server.call.pending.name: call.pending
server.call.pending.summary: An incoming call that cannot be answered yet, or null when none is pending.
server.call.pending.title: CallEvent[call.pending]

server.call.state.name: call.state
server.call.state.summary: The call changed. Sent to every client of the same account.
server.call.state.title: CallEvent[call.state]

server.calls.availability.name: calls.availability
server.calls.availability.summary: Whether this account is in a call changed.
server.calls.availability.title: CallEvent[calls.availability]

server.command.result.name: command.result
server.command.result.summary: The result of a command, matched to it by `requestId`. Acceptance starts the operation; it does not mean the call connected.
server.command.result.title: CallEvent[command.result]

server.conference.invitations.name: conference.invitations
server.conference.invitations.summary: Replaces the list of conference calls this account can join. An empty list clears it.
server.conference.invitations.title: CallEvent[conference.invitations]

server.hello.name: hello
server.hello.summary: The first event on the control socket: this connection's ID and the current calling state. Check `protocolVersion` before sending commands.
server.hello.title: CallEvent[hello]

server.media.ready.name: media.ready
server.media.ready.summary: Sent on the media socket after `media.attach` succeeds: the tracks to use.
server.media.ready.title: CallEvent[media.ready]

server.participant.updated.name: participant.updated
server.participant.updated.summary: A conference participant's membership or microphone changed. A `call.state` with the new roster follows.
server.participant.updated.title: CallEvent[participant.updated]

server.protocol.error.name: protocol.error
server.protocol.error.summary: The protocol version could not be agreed. The daemon then closes the socket with WebSocket code 1002.
server.protocol.error.title: CallEvent[protocol.error]

server.track.added.name: track.added
server.track.added.summary: A receive audio track appeared. Audio for it follows.
server.track.added.title: CallEvent[track.added]

server.track.removed.name: track.removed
server.track.removed.summary: A receive track ended. Audio for that generation stops.
server.track.removed.title: CallEvent[track.removed]

server.track.updated.name: track.updated
server.track.updated.summary: A track moved to a new generation, for example after `call.clear_audio` or a mute change. Send new audio on the new generation.
server.track.updated.title: CallEvent[track.updated]

CallAudioFormat.description:
The PCM format of call audio. The daemon currently supports only 16,000 Hz,
mono, 20 ms frames.

frameMs.description: Length of one audio frame in milliseconds.

CallAudioTrack.description: One audio stream: the single track you send, or one source you receive.

direction.description: Whether you send or receive audio on this track.

format.description: The PCM format of the track.

generation.description:
Version of the stream. Chunks for an older generation are discarded; a
new generation starts after `call.clear_audio` or a mute change.

id.description: Track ID to use in `audio.start` and `audio.chunk`.

participantId.description:
The conference participant this track carries. Omitted when the track
is not tied to a participant.

CallCapabilities.description: Calling operations that are available. A missing flag means unavailable.

conferenceAudio.description: Audio in conference calls is available.

conferenceCreate.description: Starting a conference call in a group is available.

conferenceInvite.description: Inviting more contacts into a connected conference call is available.

conferenceJoin.description: Joining a conference call from an invitation is available.

conferenceVideo.description: Video in conference calls is available. This version never sets it.

directAudio.description: Direct voice calls with one contact are available.

directVideo.description: Direct video calls are available. This version never sets it.

CallClientHello.call.hello.description:
Announce the protocol versions this client supports. Send it within five
seconds of opening the control socket, before any command.

supportedProtocolVersions.description:
One to eight distinct positive version numbers. The daemon speaks a
single version and answers `protocol.error` when the list does not
include it.

CallCommand.call.answer.description:
Answer the incoming call. The first client to answer owns the call;
others get `already_claimed`.

expectedRevision.description:
The latest offer `revision` you received. A stale revision is
rejected.

requestId.description: Your ID for this command. The `command.result` repeats it.

CallCommand.call.cancel.description: Cancel your outgoing call before the other side picks up.

expectedRevision.description:
The latest call `revision` you received. A stale revision is
rejected.

requestId.description: Your ID for this command. The `command.result` repeats it.

CallCommand.call.clear_audio.description:
Discard queued outgoing audio, for example to interrupt a reply. This
starts a new send generation, announced by `track.updated`.

requestId.description: Your ID for this command. The `command.result` repeats it.

CallCommand.call.dial.description: Start an outgoing call. The socket becomes the call's owner.

requestId.description: Your ID for this command. The `command.result` repeats it.

CallCommand.call.hangup.description:
End a call after answering or connecting. In a conference this leaves
the call without ending it for the others.

expectedRevision.description:
The latest call `revision` you received. A stale revision is
rejected.

requestId.description: Your ID for this command. The `command.result` repeats it.

CallCommand.call.invite.description:
Invite more contacts into a connected conference call you own. Results
arrive as `call.invitation_result`.

requestId.description: Your ID for this command. The `command.result` repeats it.

CallCommand.call.join.description:
Join a conference call from one of the listed invitations. The socket
becomes the call's owner, as with `call.dial`.

invitationRevision.description:
The `revision` of that entry. A stale or used invitation fails with
`offer_expired`.

requestId.description: Your ID for this command. The `command.result` repeats it.

CallCommand.call.mute.description:
Mute or unmute your outgoing audio. This also clears queued audio and
starts a new send generation, announced by `track.updated`.

muted.description: True to mute, false to unmute.

requestId.description: Your ID for this command. The `command.result` repeats it.

CallCommand.call.ready.description:
Advertise or withdraw readiness to handle call audio. A new connection
is passive until it advertises readiness.

format.description:
The PCM format you will send and receive. It must match the
daemon's audio format.

ready.description: True to advertise readiness, false to withdraw it.

requestId.description: Your ID for this command. The `command.result` repeats it.

scope.description:
Which calls readiness covers. Omitted means all. Ignored when
withdrawing readiness.

expectedRevision.description:
The latest offer `revision` you received. A stale revision is
rejected.

requestId.description: Your ID for this command. The `command.result` repeats it.

CallCommandStatus.description: How the daemon handled a command.

oneOf.description: The command started. This does not mean the call connected.
An identical earlier command was already accepted.
The command was rejected; see `code`.

CallConferenceInvitation.description: A conference call this account can join. It carries no room credentials.

groupId.description: The group the conference call is in.

invitationId.description: Opaque ID for this account. Send it in `call.join`.

revision.description: Revision of the invitation. Send it in `call.join` exactly as listed.

CallControl.description:
A control a call participant can report. A microphone update does not
change the audio format.

muted.description: True when the microphone is muted.

CallDirection.description: Whether this account placed the call or received it.

oneOf.description: Another party called this account.
This account placed the call.

CallErrorCode.description:
Why a command or socket failed. Lost replies do not authorize an automatic
retry.

oneOf.description: The message was malformed or a value was out of range.

This account is already in a call, or an earlier call's outcome is
unresolved.
Another client already answered the incoming call.
The offer or invitation is no longer available.
This socket does not own the call.
The daemon does not support this operation.
No client has advertised readiness. Send `call.ready` first.

An earlier call's outcome was never confirmed. Do not retry
automatically.
A limit was reached, such as too much queued audio.
The revision, generation or connection is out of date.
The token's scopes do not allow this action.
The connection or call is closed.

CallEvent.call.control.description:
The other party of a direct call changed a control, such as muting their
microphone. It needs no reply.

control.description: The control and its new value.

CallEvent.call.error.description:
A failure that is not tied to a command, such as an invalid message or a
missing permission. The daemon then closes the socket, except for
`outcome_unknown`, which follows `hello` and leaves it open.

CallEvent.call.invitation_result.description:
The outcome of each invited contact for a create or invite command, sent
to the call's owner.

requestId.description: The `requestId` of the create or invite command.

CallEvent.call.offered.description: An incoming call that can be answered or rejected now.

offer.description: The offer. Send its `revision` in `call.answer` or `call.reject`.

CallEvent.call.pending.description:
An incoming call that cannot be answered yet, or null when none is
pending.

offer.description: The pending call, or null to clear it.

CallEvent.call.state.description: The call changed. Sent to every client of the same account.

call.description: The call as it is now.

CallEvent.calls.availability.description: Whether this account is in a call changed.

CallEvent.command.result.description:
The result of a command, matched to it by `requestId`. Acceptance starts
the operation; it does not mean the call connected.

callId.description:
The call the command claimed. Null unless it was a dial, answer or
join that succeeded.

code.description: Why the command failed. Null unless `status` is `error`.

ownerToken.description:
Secret token for `media.attach` on the claimed call. Null unless a
call was claimed. Do not log it.

status.description: Whether the command was accepted, repeated or rejected.

CallEvent.conference.invitations.description:
Replaces the list of conference calls this account can join. An empty
list clears it.

CallEvent.hello.description:
The first event on the control socket: this connection's ID and the
current calling state. Check `protocolVersion` before sending commands.

audioFormat.description: The PCM format used for call audio.

availability.description: Whether this account is in a call.

clientId.description: ID of this connection. Send it as `clientId` in `media.attach`.

conferenceInvitations.description: Conference calls this account can join.

currentOffer.description: The incoming call that can be answered now, or null.

currentPendingOffer.description: An incoming call that cannot be answered yet, or null.

protocolVersion.description: The protocol version the daemon speaks on this socket.

CallEvent.media.ready.description:
Sent on the media socket after `media.attach` succeeds: the tracks to
use.

protocolVersion.description: The protocol version the daemon speaks on the media socket.

receiveTracks.description: The tracks for audio you receive, one per source.

sendTrack.description: The track for audio you send.

CallEvent.participant.updated.description:
A conference participant's membership or microphone changed. A
`call.state` with the new roster follows.

participant.description: The participant as it is now.

revision.description: The call revision after this change.

CallEvent.protocol.error.description:
The protocol version could not be agreed. The daemon then closes the
socket with WebSocket code 1002.

clientVersions.description: The versions the client announced. Empty when the list was invalid.

CallEvent.track.added.description: A receive audio track appeared. Audio for it follows.

CallEvent.track.removed.description: A receive track ended. Audio for that generation stops.

trackId.description: ID of the track that ended.

CallEvent.track.updated.description:
A track moved to a new generation, for example after `call.clear_audio`
or a mute change. Send new audio on the new generation.

track.description: The track with its new generation.

CallInvitationResult.description: The outcome of inviting one contact. It does not mean the contact joined.

contactId.description: The contact this result is for.

serviceCode.description: The code the service returned. Omitted when unavailable.

verificationRequired.description:
True when the service asked for a verification step. The event carries
no verification link.

CallInvitationStatus.description: What happened to one invitation. It is separate from room membership.

oneOf.description: The service accepted the invitation.
The service rejected the invitation.
The service gave no result for this contact.

The invitation may have reached the service. Do not retry
automatically.

CallKind.description: Whether a call is with one contact or with a group.

oneOf.description: A call with one contact.
A call in a group.

CallMediaCommand.audio.chunk.description:
A chunk of PCM audio. You send it on your track; the daemon sends it on
receive tracks.

generation.description: The track generation. Chunks for an older generation are discarded.

pcmBase64.description:
PCM16 little-endian samples as padded base64. A chunk you send is
whole samples, at most 65,536 bytes once decoded.

sampleOffset.description:
Position of the chunk in per-channel samples on the shared call
timeline. The daemon sets it on chunks it sends; you must not send it.

sequence.description:
Order of the chunk within its source. The daemon sets it on chunks
it sends; you must not send it.

trackId.description: The track the audio belongs to.

CallMediaCommand.audio.start.description:
Start sending audio on your track for a generation. Send it before the
first chunk, and again after each new generation.

CallMediaCommand.media.attach.description:
Attach the socket to a call you own. Send it first, within five seconds
of connecting; the daemon answers `media.ready`.

ownerToken.description:
The secret `ownerToken` from the `command.result` that claimed the
call. Do not log it.

CallMembership.description: Whether a participant is in a conference call.

oneOf.description: In the room.
Invited but not in the room.
Was in the room and left.
The server has not said.

CallOffer.description: An incoming call that can be answered or rejected now.

callType.description: Whether the call is voice or video.

kind.description: Whether the call is direct or a conference.

revision.description:
Increases when the offer changes. Send the latest value as
`expectedRevision` when answering or rejecting.

CallParticipant.description: One participant in a conference call.

membership.description: Whether the participant is in the room.

microphoneEnabled.description:
Whether the participant's microphone is on. Omitted until the server
reports it; an omitted value is unknown, not false.

participantId.description:
ID of the participant within this call. It is not a contact ID; use it
to match audio tracks to participants.

status.description: Signaling progress, separate from membership. Omitted until reported.

CallParticipantControl.description: A control reported by one participant.

participantId.description:
The participant the control belongs to. In a direct call this is the
contact ID.

CallParticipantStatus.description: Signaling progress of a participant, independent of membership.

code.description:
The status number the service reported. Keep it for codes `kind` does
not name.

CallParticipantStatusKind.description:
What a participant status code means. Cancelled, busy, rejected and no
response do not by themselves mean a participant left.

oneOf.description: Code 0: no state reported.
Code 1: in the room.
Code 2: invited, not in the room.
Code 3: invited and acknowledged, not in the room.
Code 4: left the room.
Code 5: cancelled.
Code 6: busy.
Code 7: rejected.
Code 8: no response.
Any other code. No join or departure is implied.

CallPendingOffer.description:
An incoming call that cannot be answered yet, because it is waiting for a
ready client or for the daemon to finish preparing it.

callType.description: Whether the call is voice or video.

kind.description: Whether the call is direct or a conference.

phase.description: What the call is waiting for.

CallPendingPhase.description: How far along an incoming call is before it can be answered.

oneOf.description: Waiting for a client to advertise readiness.
The daemon is preparing the call.

CallProtocolErrorCode.description: Why the daemon refused the protocol versions a client announced.

oneOf.description:
The list does not include the version the daemon speaks, or no list was
sent (a missing list means version 1).
The list is empty, null, has duplicates or is otherwise malformed.

CallReadyScope.description: Which calls a readiness announcement covers.

oneOf.description: Incoming and outgoing calls.
Outgoing calls only.
One pending incoming call.

callId.description: ID of the pending incoming call.

expectedRevision.description: The offer revision you expect; a different revision is rejected.

CallState.description:
Where a call is in its life. Stop sending audio at `ending`, and keep the
control socket connected while the daemon finishes cleanup.

oneOf.description: An incoming call is waiting to be answered or rejected.
An outgoing call is being placed.
The other side is ringing.
The call was accepted and audio is being set up.
The call is up and audio can flow.
The call is being hung up.
The call is over.
The outcome could not be confirmed.
A direct call with one contact.

contactId.description: The contact to call. A group ID is not accepted.

oneOf.description: A new conference call in a group.

groupId.description: The group to call, whose ID ends in `@chatroom`.

CallTrackDirection.description: Whether an audio track carries audio you send or audio you receive.

oneOf.description: Audio from you to the call.
Audio from the call to you.

CallType.description:
Whether a call is voice or video, independent of the media currently
negotiated. A video call can continue with audio only. This daemon places
and answers voice calls only.

oneOf.description: A voice call.
A video call.

CallView.description: A call this account is in.

callType.description: Whether the call is voice or video.

controls.description:
The latest controls reported by the other party of a direct call, also
given to a newly connected observer. Omitted until one is reported.

direction.description: Whether this account placed the call or received it.

groupId.description: The group of a conference call. Omitted for a direct call.

kind.description: Whether the call is direct or a conference.

ownedByThisClient.description: True when this connection owns the call. Always false in HTTP snapshots.

participants.description: The latest conference roster. Omitted for a direct call.

revision.description:
Increases each time the call changes. Send the latest value as
`expectedRevision`.

state.description: Where the call is in its life.

CallsAvailability.description: Whether this account is in a call.

busy.description:
True while this account has a call, including one whose outcome is
unresolved, so a new call cannot start.

ownedByThisClient.description: True when this connection owns that call.

info.description: Call commands, events and audio on two WebSockets of the agent-wechat daemon. Both speak call protocol version 2. The daemon's HTTP routes are described in openapi.json.

controlSend.summary: Messages the daemon sends to the client.

mediaReceive.summary: Messages the daemon accepts from the client.

mediaSend.summary: Messages the daemon sends to the client.
